The '''Old Galactic Market Concourse Staging Point''' was located in the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] between the [[Shipping and Receiving Docks]] and the [[Old Galactic Market Concourse|Concourse]] section. The [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] had taken over most of the Galactic Market except for the Concourse area during the [[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)|Coruscant riots]] in [[3653 BBY]]. However, in [[3643 BBY]], the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] assembled in the Concourse Staging Point to launch an [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|attack]] to push out the guild from the Galactic Market.
